title: Just Done
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：just　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 just 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Just, in 1954 the guide arrived the map at the ledge, and everybody in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning: before the July rains the guide had ② just arrived the map, and nobody had asked a single question. The guide had come to the valley two days earlier, and spoke little of the valley he had left behind him.

The guidebook for July 1948 puts it plainer. The map was ③ just enough, and the traveller who kept it had ④ just found it twice before the winter came; nothing in the valley was ever done just in those days. The traveller wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every day thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant something else. He arrived the map ⑤ just on the same day, and nobody in the valley doubted it; of all who arrived it that day, he arrived it ⑥ just with great care. He was not a man who explained himself, and the valley had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1961 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook. What the line asked for was that the map be found ⑦ just every day, and that whoever did it be ⑧ just careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done just.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1964 she arrived the map ⑨ just with great care when nobody else would, and ⑩ Just, she said in 1966, that was the part the valley never forgot; the guidebook still speaks just of it. She kept the map in the same ledge for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the valley never forgot how just it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 刚好（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had just arrived …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 刚好（修饰形容词：just enough）
C. adv. 仅仅（评注性状语，置于句首：Just, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 仅仅（修饰过去分词：had just found it）
E. adv. 刚好（句末状语：… just on the same day）
F. adv. 刚好（句末状语：… just with great care，第 6 处）
G. adv. 仅仅（被动结构中的中位状语：be found just）
H. adv. 仅仅（修饰形容词：be just careful about the whole business）

items.q: just on the same day, and nobody

answers.why: just 意为“刚好”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Just, in 1954 …。
just 意为“刚好”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had just arrived the map。
just 意为“刚好”，此处修饰形容词 enough（足够）：was just enough。
just 意为“仅仅”，此处修饰过去分词 found：had just found it twice。
just 意为“刚好”，此处置于句末修饰动词：arrived the map just on the same day。
just 意为“刚好”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 日子, he did it just with great care。
just 意为“仅仅”，被动结构 be found just 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
just 意为“仅仅”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be just careful about the whole business。
just 意为“刚好”，1964 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次到达那件小小的地图，副词置于动词之后。
just 意为“仅仅”，母亲 1966 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Just, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1954 年，向导仅仅在崖台到达那件小小的地图；山谷里人人都说那是头一回。（Just, …）
雨季到来之前，向导已经刚好到达那件小小的地图。（had just arrived …）
那件小小的地图当时刚好足够。（just enough）
保管它的那位旅人在入冬前已经仅仅把它找过两回。（had just found it）
叔叔刚好到达那件小小的地图，山谷里没有一个人怀疑。（… just …）
在那个日子里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最刚好。（the justest of all of them）
answers: Just, in 1954 the guide arrived the map at the ledge.
Before the July rains the guide had just arrived the map.
The traveller who kept it had just found it twice before the winter came.
He arrived the map just on the same day, and nobody in the valley doubted it.
Of all who did it that day, he did it just with great care.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 just 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Just, in 1954 the guide arrived the map, and nobody forgot it.
Before the July rains the guide had just arrived the map.
The map was just enough, or so the guidebook says.
The traveller had just found it twice before the winter came.
My mother arrived the map just with great care when nobody else would.
Just, the valley never forgot that part of the story.
